skill.summary: Books, tracks, and reminds you of appointments through online booking or phone-call scripts, managing the full appointment lifecycle and reminders.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of appointment-manager skill.
- Book, track, and remind users about appointments of any type.
- Supports both online booking (automated) and phone-only providers (call script provided).
- Customizable multi-stage reminder chain with prep notes and follow-ups.
- Maintains provider and appointment log files for tracking and rebooking.
- Integrates with Google Calendar (if connected) and adapts reminders to user preferences.
